captionLines: The People of the State of New York, Appellant,

qualifierLines: {**29 NY3d at 116} OPINION OF THE COURT

In Richmond County, defendant pleaded guilty to first-degree sodomy committed against one boy. Pursuant to a plea agreement, Richmond County Supreme Court sentenced defendant to a term of 7- to 15 years' imprisonment, to run concurrently with defendant's Queens County sentence.

In Queens County, defendant pleaded guilty to second-degree rape of the 12-year-old girl, and to first-degree attempted sodomy and two counts of first-degree sexual abuse as to the three remaining victims. During the plea allocution, the People agreed not to pursue additional charges as to a fifth named victim whom defendant confessed he also sexually abused. Pursuant to a second plea agreement, Queens County Supreme{**29 NY3d at 117} Court sentenced defendant to 15 years' imprisonment, to run concurrently with lesser terms and with defendant's Richmond County sentence, followed by four years' postrelease supervision.
